about_the_game:
This DLC pack contains:

A creative mode extension!

This extension offers them a free mode, also known as creative mode. Here you are not limited and can realize your dreams. Here you can use everything the game has to offer. You'll get instant access to all the content you need to build and survive, such as items, clothing and resources.

- In creative mode, achievements become inactive for fairness.

This product requires the Steam version of the main game "Pirates" to play.
